R141.note: Adds @csrf_protect decorator mirroring the sibling route; clean, no other change.

R142.note: Replaces seeded Random with RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes; output shape (Base64 token) unchanged.

R143.note: Adds $this->authorize('refund', $order) before refund() with a matching ownership/admin policy; clean.

R144.note: Whitelist fully blocks metacharacters but keeps the shell (cmd /C) when the ping/nslookup calls could each be run without a shell at all -- wrong shape for this sink despite closing it.

R145.note: Allowlist maps plugin name to canonical module before import_module; clean.

R146.note: jwt.verify with algorithms allowlist correctly closes it, but the sample ships a hardcoded fallback secret ('your-secret-key') if JWT_SECRET is unset, which would silently make tokens forgeable again.

R147.note: PreparedStatement with bound parameter; finally block correctly updated to close the new type.

R148.note: Removes [IgnoreAntiforgeryToken] so the app's global antiforgery filter applies; clean.

R149.note: PreparedStatement with bound parameter; matches sibling Case01 fix.

R150.note: GetFullPath + StartsWith containment check with separator correctly catches Path.Combine's absolute-override behavior.

R151.note: Encode.forHtml() at the output sink; preserves surrounding markup.

R152.note: NewParser+WithValidMethods restores algorithm allowlisting; the required claims-assertion pointer change is stated openly and doesn't alter behavior.

R153.note: Narrow DTO decode plus hardcoded IsAdmin=false matches the contract that message-derived admin claims must never be honored.

R154.note: resolve-then-normalize with startsWith(BASE_DIR) check catches both dot-dot traversal and absolute-path override before the read.

R155.note: AST allowlist correctly blocks attribute/call/subscript access, but silently permits Pow/Mod/FloorDiv beyond the contract's stated +,-,*,/ (also a latent DoS via attacker-controlled exponents), undisclosed.

R157.note: strnlen bounded to sizeof(record->name) stops at the field boundary, never reading into flags.

R158.note: snprintf with truncation check rejects oversized input rather than truncating; format matches the required output.

R159.note: allowed_classes=false blocks object instantiation while preserving array/scalar decode; matches documented CWE-502 PHP guidance.

R160.note: Tika magic-byte detection plus re-encode through ImageIO and a server-derived extension; CREATE_NEW vs REPLACE_EXISTING change is disclosed and immaterial given UUID naming.

R161.note: Bounds check switched to segment.size(), matching the contract that callers no longer need an agreeing claimed capacity.

R162.note: Query builder ->where() binds region as a parameter; preserves original select/group/order shape.

R163.note: DOM construction (createElement/textContent) replaces innerHTML; preserves the styled span and layout.

R164.note: Deny-all JexlSandbox with explicit ReportRow allow; primitive amount/region/owner context vars remain usable without reflection.

R165.note: secrets.randbelow() reproduces random.randint's inclusive range; same failure mode as before if min>max.

R166.note: Adds a size check before memcpy, returning false rather than reading past the vector.

R167.note: Removes the SignatureValidator override so the default pipeline performs real signature/issuer/audience checks.

R168.note: Rejects absolute paths and leading '..', then Clean + prefix-with-separator containment check before ReadFile.

R169.note: Argument-list subprocess.run without shell=True; added filename validation is disclosed defense-in-depth.

R170.note: SecureRandom replaces java.util.Random for the token; same downstream string conversion.

R171.note: DomSanitizer.sanitize(HTML) replaces the bypass call; Angular's built-in sanitizer preserves b/em/a while stripping script vectors, matching the contract.

R172.note: PreparedStatement with bound parameter; matches sibling Case01/Case13 fixes.

R173.note: Long-cast multiplication with an explicit overflow check before narrowing; returns 400 on out-of-range product as required.

R174.note: htmlspecialchars() with ENT_QUOTES at the final output sink; clean.

R175.note: Structured logging placeholder replaces string interpolation; standard ILogger fix.

R176.note: Replaces exec() with Files.list() printing to System.out/err, but the HttpServletResponse parameter is now completely unused -- silently drops whatever output the endpoint used to return to the caller, with no disclosure of that loss.

R177.note: offset+length>capacity is the classic unsigned-addition overflow bounds check: a large offset plus large length can wrap past capacity and still pass, leaving the same out-of-bounds write reachable via different inputs.

R178.note: AST denylist only scans InvocationExpressionSyntax method names and 'using' directives -- fully-qualified names (System.IO.File.ReadAllText(...) with no using) and object-creation expressions (new FileStream(...)) bypass it entirely, and restricting references to System.Private.CoreLib doesn't actually exclude File/Process/Reflection since .NET Core forwards those types through CoreLib.

R179.note: Inserts '--' before filenames so tar treats them as literal operands; matches the contract exactly.

R180.note: Magic-byte detection via file-type against an allowlist, server-derived extension, temp-then-rename; disclosed size limit and cleanup additions.
